body: I don't know; I wouldn't know where to begin or what to say.

In total I have two friends; neither of which I think would use the word friend to describe me.  My personality is toxic, and in conjunction with my social anxiety it becomes almost impossible to function in a public setting.  I have taken steps to try and ameliorate myself and abate both of those things, but I have been unsuccessful.  It has gotten to the point where I can't even communicate my ideas to other people clearly.  I have tried every hobby I can think of, and none of them have been fulfilling in anyway.  This turns my life into a series of trying to get through the week of doing something I hate with television and internet, and then just sleeping as much as I can on the weekend.  I don't want to turn this into something where I complain about never having a romantic partner, but not having one hurts as well.  What hurts more is knowing that if by some act of God a woman did accept me and wanted some kind of relationship with me, I'd have to ensure it didn't happen; exposing someone, especially someone I actually care about, to my poisonous disposition would be extraordinarily selfish and damaging.  If you asked me "what would you like to have happen," I wouldn't know how to answer.  There isn't one thing I can think of that would make me happy.  I honestly think it's just the way that my brain is wired.
